description: Proposed new garden room to replace existing garden storage, landscaping, removal of existing staircase from ground floor flat, bin storage and all associated works
subdivision_of_building: Lower Ground Floor Flat Garden ONLY

open_spaces_details.description: Existing sheds equate to 12.1 sqm of garden storage area. Proposed garden room totals 15.5sqm.

decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans Location Plan, 23-Jul-2025; EX-00; EX-01; EX-02; PA-00, Rev P-03; PA-01, Rev P-03; PA-02, Rev P-03; PA-03, Rev P-03; PA-04, Rev P-03; PA-05, Rev P-03; PA-06, Rev P-03.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for purposes incidental to the use of the main property (Flat A, 76 Belsize Paek Gardens) and shall not be used as a separate residential dwelling or a business premises.    
   
Reason: To safeguard the amenity of the residential use, adjoining premises, and the area generally in accordance with policies A1 and A4 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.   
Condition : 5 - Prior to commencement of development, full details in respect of the living roof (for both the outbuilding and bin storage area) shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. The details shall include:  
 
i. a detailed scheme of maintenance 
ii. sections at a scale of 1:20 with manufacturer's details demonstrating the construction and materials used 
iii. full details of planting species and density.  
 
The living roof shall be fully provided in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and thereafter retained and maintained in accordance with the approved scheme.    

Reason: In order to ensure the development undertakes reasonable measures to take account of biodiversity and the water environment in accordance with policies CC1, CC2, CC3, D1, D2 and A3 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
  
Condition : 6 - The works hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the methods (including tree protection measures) outlined in the submitted Arboricultural Impact Assessment and Arboricultural Method Statement, prepared by Connick Tree Consultants, dated 10th July 2025. 
 
Reason: To ensure that the development will not have an adverse impact on existing trees and in order to maintain the character and amenity of the area in accordance policies A2 and A3 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.  
Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the approved drawings, the existing rear first floor balcony shall be retained and not extended, and the infill balustrades must match the existing balustrades.

Reason: To protect the amenities of the adjoining neighbours and to safeguard the appearance of the building and character of the area in accordance with the requirements of policies A1, D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
